neighbours.label: the first element symbol of a chemical formula written without spaces, when that symbol has two letters (the metal symbol right before a glued-on second element, as in a nitride, oxide or chloride formula); the element's name spelled out, or its symbol standing alone, stays quiet
neighbours.short: start of a chemical formula (Ti in TiN)
neighbours.notes: Blind test: sentences written by a second author who saw only the label. Exploration also found the pole on prefixes repeated from earlier glued names when the tokenizer splits them (fooBar/fooBaz, KingSlayer/KingMaker, self.colorRed/colorGreen ~0.4-0.6), and on CamelCase code names in its top examples (PythonWin, WebAgg, LoggerRx); single invented CamelCase names and one-token names (marginTop) stay low. The output suppresses space-prefixed capitals, consistent with predicting a glued-on capital next. Feeders step (play step, no --down) hit CUDA OOM, so this mission ran without the feeders-first arm.
